collection: Frontier Multimodal & Scientific AI Literature (2025-2026 with seminal foundations)
verification_note: Every arXiv ID resolved to the stated title via the official arXiv API; every DOI resolved via Crossref or the publisher/preprint server; venue/status cross-checked on 2026-11-20.

papers.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision (CLIP)
papers.license_access: MIT (code and weights); arXiv open access
papers.methods: Contrastive image-text pretraining of a ViT/ResNet image encoder and Transformer text encoder on 400M web image-text pairs; zero-shot classification via natural-language prompts.
papers.benchmarks: Zero-shot transfer on 27 datasets incl. ImageNet (76.2% zero-shot ViT-L/14), OCR, action recognition, geo-localization, fine-grained recognition.
papers.key_contribution: Established natural-language-supervised contrastive pretraining as the default recipe for vision foundation models; enabled zero-shot recognition and the text encoders used by modern text-to-image/video models.
papers.limitations: Struggles with counting, fine-grained spatial reasoning and out-of-distribution abstract tasks; data curation opaque; known demographic biases; compute-heavy at scale.
papers.research_relevance: Backbone of open-vocabulary perception, multimodal retrieval, and conditioning for diffusion models; baseline for nearly all subsequent VLM work.
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
papers.license_access: MIT (code); Stable Diffusion weights under CreativeML OpenRAIL licenses (use-restricted)
papers.methods: Two-stage approach: perceptual autoencoder compresses images to latent space; diffusion model trained in latent space with cross-attention conditioning (text, layout, etc.).
papers.benchmarks: FID/Inception Score on ImageNet class-conditional, CelebA-HQ, LSUN; text-to-image on MS-COCO (Stable Diffusion follow-up); inpainting/super-resolution.
papers.key_contribution: Latent-space diffusion made high-resolution text-to-image synthesis computationally tractable; basis of Stable Diffusion and the open generative-image ecosystem.
papers.limitations: Sequential sampling is slow; struggles with precise text rendering, compositionality and counting; trained on LAION web data with associated bias/copyright concerns.
papers.research_relevance: Foundational generative prior reused across image, video, 3D and even molecular generation; cross-attention conditioning pattern is ubiquitous.
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: DINOv2: Learning Robust Visual Features without Supervision
papers.license_access: Code Apache 2.0; model weights originally CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial) - verify current terms on repo
papers.methods: Self-supervised ViT pretraining combining DINO image-level and iBOT patch-level objectives with distillation, on a curated 142M-image dataset built via automatic deduplication/retrieval.
papers.benchmarks: Linear-probe and k-NN on ImageNet; frozen-backbone transfer to depth estimation, semantic segmentation (ADE20K), retrieval, video understanding.
papers.key_contribution: Showed pure self-supervision on curated data yields universal frozen visual features competitive with or better than weakly/text-supervised features across tasks.
papers.limitations: Training data not released; feature quality degrades for domains far from natural images; high compute for largest models.
papers.research_relevance: Default frozen visual encoder in VLMs, video models and robotics policies; template for data-curation-centric SSL.
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: DINOv3
papers.license_access: Apache 2.0 (code and most weights); see model cards for any exceptions
papers.methods: Scaled self-supervised ViT (up to 7B params) with Gram anchoring to prevent degradation of dense patch features during long training; trained on 1.7B curated images; distillation to a family of smaller models.
papers.benchmarks: Dense prediction (segmentation, depth, 3D correspondence), global recognition/retrieval, video tracking; strong results on satellite/aerial imagery as well as natural images.
papers.key_contribution: Fixes the long-training degradation of patch-level features (Gram anchoring) and demonstrates SSL scaling to multi-billion-parameter vision backbones with state-of-the-art dense features.
papers.limitations: Very large training compute; high-resolution dense tasks still benefit from task-specific decoders; pretraining data not released.
papers.research_relevance: Current default general-purpose visual encoder for perception stacks, robotics, and multimodal pipelines in 2025-2026.
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: SAM 2: Segment Anything in Images and Videos
papers.license_access: Apache 2.0 (code and model checkpoints); SA-V dataset CC BY 4.0
papers.methods: Promptable unified image/video segmentation with a streaming-memory transformer: memory attention conditions each frame on past predictions and user prompts for real-time masklet propagation.
papers.benchmarks: Interactive video object segmentation (DAVIS, MOSE, SA-V), image segmentation (SA-23); zero-shot video segmentation accuracy and speed (~44 FPS).
papers.key_contribution: Extended the promptable segmentation foundation-model paradigm from images to video with a single model plus the largest video-segmentation dataset (SA-V).
papers.limitations: Can lose objects under long occlusions or crowded similar objects; masks can flicker; fine part-level boundaries still imperfect.
papers.research_relevance: De facto annotation and perception tool for video understanding, robotics data pipelines, and medical/scientific imaging.
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: Depth Anything V2
papers.license_access: Apache 2.0 (code and small model); larger checkpoints CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial)
papers.methods: Monocular depth estimation trained with a teacher on large-scale pseudo-labeled real images plus precise synthetic labels; DINOv2 encoder with DPT-style decoder.
papers.benchmarks: Zero-shot relative depth on KITTI, NYUv2, ETH3D, ScanNet, DIODE; DA-2K fine-grained relative-depth benchmark.
papers.key_contribution: Demonstrated that replacing most labeled real data with synthetic labels + pseudo-labeled real images dramatically improves fine-grained, robust zero-shot depth.
papers.limitations: Predicts relative (affine-invariant) rather than metric depth without extra heads; struggles with mirrors/transparent surfaces and dynamic scenes.
papers.research_relevance: Widely used geometry prior for 3D reconstruction, video generation conditioning, robotics and AR.
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: Qwen2.5-VL Technical Report
papers.license_access: Apache 2.0 for 7B; Qwen license terms for 3B/72B (permissive with conditions); see model cards
papers.methods: Native dynamic-resolution ViT with window attention + SwiGLU/RMSNorm, MLP vision-language merger, MRoPE aligned to absolute time, dynamic-FPS video training; pretraining scaled to 4.1T tokens; SFT+DPO post-training.
papers.benchmarks: MMMU, MMStar, MMBench, MathVista, DocVQA, OCRBench, RefCOCO grounding, ScreenSpot/ScreenSpot-Pro, OSWorld/AndroidWorld agents, Video-MME/LVBench long-video QA.
papers.key_contribution: Open-weights flagship VLM with precise object localization (boxes/points in absolute coordinates), robust document parsing, hour-long video understanding with second-level event localization, and strong GUI-agent capability.
papers.limitations: Hallucination on fine-grained counting/OCR persists; long-video reasoning still below human; largest models need heavy inference resources.
papers.research_relevance: Reference open VLM for grounding, document AI and GUI agents; widely used baseline and backbone in 2025 research.
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: Gemma 3 Technical Report
authors: Gemma Team (Aishwarya Kamath, Johan Ferret, Shreya Pathak, et al., Google DeepMind)
papers.license_access: Gemma Terms of Use (open weights, prohibited-use policy); code Apache 2.0
papers.methods: Multimodal extension of Gemma LLMs with a SigLIP vision encoder, 5:1 local:global attention interleaving for 128K context, QK-norm; distillation-based post-training; multimodal pretraining on image-text data with pan-and-scan for high-res inputs.
papers.benchmarks: MMLU, LiveCodeBench, MMMU, DocVQA, Video-MME, MATH; LMSYS Chatbot Arena Elo (27B among top open models per report).
papers.key_contribution: Strong open-weight multimodal models in small-footprint sizes (single-GPU 27B class) with 128K context and 140+ language coverage.
papers.limitations: Multimodal ability limited vs frontier proprietary VLMs (no native video encoder beyond frame sampling); license is not OSI-open; safety evaluations abbreviated.
papers.research_relevance: Practical open multimodal backbone for on-device/low-budget research and fine-tuning studies.
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: InternVL3: Exploring Advanced Training and Test-Time Recipes for Open-Source Multimodal Models
authors: et al. (OpenGVLab, Shanghai AI Lab et al.)
papers.license_access: MIT (code); weights MIT for most sizes (see model cards)
papers.methods: Native multimodal pretraining (single-stage joint language+vision) instead of post-hoc alignment; variable visual position encoding; Mixed Preference Optimization (MPO); test-time scaling via Best-of-N with visual PRM.
papers.benchmarks: MMMU, MMBench, MathVista, OCRBench, HallusionBench, MMVet, Video-MME; InternVL3-78B reported as leading open-source MLLM on MMMU at release.
papers.key_contribution: Showed joint native pretraining plus MPO and test-time scaling closes much of the gap between open and proprietary multimodal models.
papers.limitations: Full training data recipe only partially released; reasoning traces inherit text-model weaknesses; compute-intensive largest variants.
papers.research_relevance: Template for open-source VLM training recipes; strong baseline for multimodal reasoning research.
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: Molmo and PixMo: Open Weights and Open Data for State-of-the-Art Vision-Language Models
papers.model_data_url: https://huggingface.co/allenai (Molmo 7B/72B); PixMo dataset collection on HF
papers.license_access: Apache 2.0 (code and most model weights); PixMo data under permissive terms (see dataset cards)
papers.methods: Fully open VLM pipeline: captioner-annotated dense image captions (PixMo-Cap), pointing/counting supervision (PixMo-Points), academic-budget training on <1M highly curated samples instead of billion-scale web pairs; frozen LLM + CLIP-style encoder with overlapping-crop high-res input.
papers.benchmarks: Academic VQA suite (11 benchmarks), human preference Elo, counting (PixMo-Count), pointing/grounding, AndroidControl GUI actions.
papers.key_contribution: Demonstrated data quality beats data scale: open-data VLMs trained without any proprietary distillation matched GPT-4o-class systems on several benchmarks; released all data.
papers.limitations: 72B variant best but heavy; multilingual and long-video abilities limited; dense-caption style can miss aesthetic/creative tasks.
papers.research_relevance: Key reproducibility reference: one of the few fully open (weights+data+recipe) frontier-class VLMs.
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: Janus-Pro: Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation with Data and Model Scaling
papers.license_access: MIT (code); DeepSeek Model License for weights (permissive with use restrictions)
papers.methods: Decoupled visual encoding for understanding (SigLIP) vs generation (VQ tokenizer) into a single autoregressive Transformer; scaled training data (incl. ~72M synthetic aesthetic images) and model size to 7B.
papers.benchmarks: GenEval and DPG-Bench (text-to-image), MMBench/SEED/GQA/MM-Vet (understanding); Janus-Pro-7B beats DALL-E 3/SD3-Medium on GenEval per report.
papers.key_contribution: Simple, scalable recipe proving a unified AR model can be simultaneously a strong image understander and generator, rivaling specialist models at 7B scale.
papers.limitations: Generation resolution capped (384px); no native video/audio; understanding trails specialist VLMs on OCR/document tasks.
papers.research_relevance: Reference architecture for unified understanding+generation LMMs, a major 2025-2026 research direction.
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: Video Generation Models as World Simulators (Sora technical report)
papers.license_access: Closed model; report freely accessible; product access via OpenAI (Sora; Sora 2 released Sep 2025)
papers.methods: Diffusion transformer operating on spacetime patches of a learned compressed video latent space; joint training on images and videos of variable durations/resolutions/aspect ratios; LLM-based re-captioning of training videos (DALL-E 3 style).
papers.benchmarks: Qualitative scaling study of quality vs training compute; no standardized public benchmark; human-preference comparisons by third parties (e.g., VBench evaluations of the product).
papers.key_contribution: Demonstrated LLM-style scaling for video generation: a single patchified diffusion transformer generates up to ~1-minute coherent high-fidelity video, with emergent 3D consistency and persistence, motivating 'video model as world simulator' research.
papers.limitations: Reported physics/causality failures (objects appearing/vanishing, left-right confusion); cherry-picked demos; no architecture/data/eval details; no public weights.
papers.research_relevance: Catalyzed the 2024-2026 video foundation-model race (Veo, Kling, HunyuanVideo, Wan, Movie Gen) and world-model research for robotics/simulation.
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: HunyuanVideo: A Systematic Framework for Large Video Generative Models
papers.license_access: Tencent Hunyuan Community License (free use with conditions; commercial limits)
papers.methods: 13B-parameter video diffusion model: causal 3D VAE latent space, unified image-video training, dual-stream + single-stream transformer blocks with 3D RoPE, MLLM-based text encoder plus a prompt-rewrite model; curated data pipeline with filtering ladders.
papers.benchmarks: Human evaluation vs closed models (Runway Gen-3, Luma 1.6, top Chinese models); VBench; text alignment/motion quality/vision quality ratings.
papers.key_contribution: First major open-weights video foundation model at 13B scale closing much of the gap to closed systems, with a documented data-to-model systematic framework.
papers.limitations: Long-duration consistency limited (~5s native); high VRAM requirements; text rendering and complex multi-actor interactions remain weak.
papers.research_relevance: Community base model for fine-tuning (LoRAs, control adapters) and video-diffusion research.
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: Wan: Open and Advanced Large-Scale Video Generative Models
papers.license_access: Apache 2.0 (code and Wan2.1 weights)
papers.methods: Diffusion transformer with a spatio-temporal variational autoencoder (Wan-VAE) supporting 1080p encode/decode; full-attention DiT with T5 text conditioning; 1.5B-video curated pipeline; T2V, I2V, editing, text-to-image in one framework.
papers.benchmarks: VBench (T2V/I2V leaderboards at release), human preference studies; 1.3B variant benchmarked for consumer-GPU feasibility.
papers.key_contribution: Fully Apache-2.0 open, multi-task video foundation model family at competitive quality, plus an efficient 1.3B model enabling broad academic access.
papers.limitations: Clip duration short (seconds); physical reasoning and fine hand/face detail imperfect; identity consistency across shots unsolved.
papers.research_relevance: Permissive-license baseline driving open video-generation research, distillation and control-conditioning work in 2025-2026.
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: Movie Gen: A Cast of Media Foundation Models
papers.license_access: No public weights or code; paper open access
papers.methods: Family of media foundation models: 30B text-to-video diffusion transformer with flow-matching objective and temporal autoencoder; personalized video from identity image; precise video editing; 13B audio generation model for synchronized sound/effects.
papers.benchmarks: Human-preference A/B tests vs Sora, Runway Gen-3, Luma, Kling, ElevenLabs (audio); Movie Gen Video/Audio Benches; net win rates reported.
papers.key_contribution: Detailed 92-page account of large-scale video+audio generation training/inference engineering, with state-of-the-art human preference and integrated audio-visual generation.
papers.limitations: Not released - irreproducible; editing and personalization safety issues (deepfake risk); compute scale beyond academic reach.
papers.research_relevance: Definitive reference for video+audio joint generation and flow-matching training recipes at scale.
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (Whisper)
papers.license_access: MIT (code and weights)
papers.methods: Encoder-decoder Transformer trained on 680k hours of weakly labeled web audio with multitask format (transcription, translation, language ID, timestamps, VAD) via token-prompted decoding.
papers.benchmarks: Zero-shot WER on LibriSpeech, Common Voice, CoVoST2 translation, Fleurs multilingual; robustness suite vs supervised baselines (avg relative error reduction ~55%).
papers.key_contribution: Proved weakly supervised scale alone yields robust, zero-shot multilingual ASR rivaling human accuracy, obviating dataset-specific fine-tuning.
papers.limitations: Hallucinated text in silence/noise; weaker on low-resource languages; long-form decoding can repeat/skip; audio-only (no speaker diarization).
papers.research_relevance: Universal audio front-end for speech LLMs, video understanding pipelines and dataset construction.
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: Seamless: Multilingual Expressive and Streaming Speech Translation (SeamlessM4T v2)
papers.venue: arXiv preprint (Dec 2023); components in NeurIPS 2023 D&B
papers.license_access: Code MIT; model weights CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial); datasets CC licenses
papers.methods: Multitask UnitY2 architecture: speech-to-unit translation with w2v-BERT 2.0 encoder + text/unit decoders, multilingual HiFi-GAN vocoder; expressive prosody preservation; EMMA streaming policy with monotonic attention for ~2s latency.
papers.benchmarks: Speech-to-speech/text translation across ~100 languages (Fleurs, CoVoST2), BLASER 2.0 quality scores, ASR-BLEU; robustness to background noise and speaker variation; toxicity evaluations.
papers.key_contribution: First massively multilingual system unifying speech-to-speech, speech-to-text and text-to-speech translation with expressivity transfer and low-latency streaming.
papers.limitations: Non-commercial license limits deployment; hallucination/toxicity risks in generation; expressive mode coverage limited to a subset of languages.
papers.research_relevance: Reference for direct S2ST, unit-based generation and simultaneous translation policies.
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: Moshi: a speech-text foundation model for real-time dialogue
papers.license_access: Code Apache 2.0/CC-BY; weights CC BY 4.0 (see repo)
papers.methods: Full-duplex spoken dialogue foundation model: text LLM backbone (Helium 7B) with joint text+audio token streams over the Mimi neural audio codec; inner-monologue text/audio alignment; multi-stream modeling of two speakers for real-time (~200ms latency) conversation.
papers.benchmarks: Spoken QA (Web Questions, TriviaQA audio), audio modeling perplexity, Mimi codec reconstruction metrics, human naturalness ratings; latency measurements.
papers.key_contribution: First open full-duplex speech-to-speech dialogue model eliminating the ASR->LLM->TTS pipeline, achieving real-time conversational interaction.
papers.limitations: English/French-centric; factual accuracy below text LLMs; no tool use; safety guardrails minimal.
papers.research_relevance: Blueprint for omni-modal real-time assistants (cf. GPT-4o voice mode) and end-to-end speech-language modeling.
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: Qwen2-Audio Technical Report
papers.license_access: Apache 2.0 (code and weights; see model card)
papers.methods: Large audio-language model pairing a Whisper-style audio encoder with Qwen2-7B LLM; natural-language-prompted multi-task pretraining replacing hierarchical task tags; DPO alignment; supports voice chat and audio analysis modes.
papers.benchmarks: AIR-Bench, MMAU, clotho/Audiocaps captioning, CoVoST2 translation, VocalSound, SER; SOTA among open audio LLMs at release.
papers.key_contribution: Showed task-tag-free natural-language audio instruction tuning scales to a universal audio understanding/chat model.
papers.limitations: 30-second audio window; no speech output (text only); weak on long recordings and diarization.
papers.research_relevance: Common open baseline for audio understanding and a stepping stone to omni-modal (Qwen2.5-Omni) models.
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control
papers.license_access: Closed weights; paper open access; Open X-Embodiment dataset partially available
papers.methods: Co-fine-tunes PaLI-X/PaLM-E VLMs on web vision-language data plus robot trajectory data, discretizing 6-DoF+terminate actions into text tokens so actions are generated as language.
papers.benchmarks: RT-1 evaluation suite plus emergent-skill evaluations (symbol understanding, reasoning, person recognition) on a mobile manipulator; ~2x generalization gain over RT-1 on novel objects/backgrounds.
papers.key_contribution: First demonstration that web-scale VLM pretraining transfers semantic knowledge into end-to-end robot control, launching the VLA model paradigm.
papers.limitations: Only ~1-2 Hz control; no dexterous/bimanual skills; closed weights; emergent abilities limited to what co-fine-tuning preserves.
papers.research_relevance: Foundational VLA reference for subsequent open models (OpenVLA, pi0, GR00T).
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
authors: et al. (Stanford, UC Berkeley, Toyota Research)
papers.license_access: MIT (code and model weights)
papers.methods: 7B VLA built on Prismatic VLM (SigLIP+DINOv2 fused features + Llama 2 backbone), fine-tuned on Open X-Embodiment trajectories with discretized 7-DoF action tokens; LoRA fine-tuning and 4-bit quantization recipes for consumer GPUs.
papers.benchmarks: WidowX and Google-robot BridgeData V2/Fractal manipulation tasks: outperformed RT-2-X (55B) with 7x fewer params; LIBERO in follow-ups; fine-tuning generalization studies.
papers.key_contribution: First strong fully open (weights+code+recipe) generalist robot policy, enabling community VLA fine-tuning research.
papers.limitations: Single-arm, low-frequency control; no proprioception/history; sensitive to camera pose; action discretization limits dexterity.
papers.research_relevance: De facto open VLA baseline; substrate for dozens of 2025 follow-ups (fine-tuning, RL post-training, fast tokenizers).
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: pi_0: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control
papers.model_data_url: https://huggingface.co/lerobot (openpi pi0 checkpoints); pi cross-embodiment dataset (not fully public)
papers.license_access: Apache 2.0 (openpi code and released checkpoints)
papers.methods: VLM backbone (PaliGemma 3B + action expert) trained with flow matching to output continuous 50-step action chunks at up to 50 Hz; pretraining on 10k+ hours across 7 robot embodiments incl. bimanual and mobile manipulators; complex-task post-training.
papers.benchmarks: Laundry folding, table bussing, box assembly, grocery bagging - long-horizon dexterous tasks exceeding prior state of the art in duration and complexity (paper reports multi-minute autonomous episodes).
papers.key_contribution: First flow-matching VLA achieving dexterous, high-frequency, long-horizon manipulation across embodiments; continuous-action alternative to tokenized VLAs.
papers.limitations: Largest training runs used proprietary data; success still brittle on novel scenes/objects; high inference compute for flow steps.
papers.research_relevance: Dominant recipe for 2025-2026 generalist policies (pi0.5, GR00T follow-ups); openpi made it reproducible.
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: GR00T N1: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Humanoid Robots
papers.license_access: Apache 2.0 (code); NVIDIA Open Model License for weights (permissive)
papers.methods: Dual-system humanoid foundation model: System-2 VLM (Eagle-2 SMOLVLM-based) for vision-language reasoning at ~10 Hz, System-1 diffusion-transformer action module generating 16-step action chunks at 120 Hz; trained on real humanoid teleop data + synthetic trajectories (GR00T-Mimic/Blueprint) + internet video.
papers.benchmarks: GR-1 humanoid (Fourier) tabletop tasks: standard, language-following, novel-object and novel-instruction generalization; simulation benchmarks; cross-embodiment (1X Neo) fine-tuning in follow-ups.
papers.key_contribution: First open-weight foundation model aimed at full-size humanoid manipulation, with a fast/slow dual-system architecture separating semantic reasoning from motor control.
papers.limitations: Task set still tabletop-centric; locomotion not learned end-to-end; limited public evaluation on non-NVIDIA hardware.
papers.research_relevance: Anchor open model of the humanoid foundation-model wave; benchmark for VLA + diffusion-action hybrid designs.

papers.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
papers.model_data_url: Mip-NeRF360 / Tanks&Temples / Deep Blending evaluation scenes (linked from repo)
papers.license_access: Custom Inria research license (free for research/evaluation; commercial requires license)
papers.methods: Represents scenes as anisotropic 3D Gaussians with spherical-harmonic appearance; differentiable tile-based rasterizer; interleaved optimization and adaptive density control (clone/split/prune).
papers.benchmarks: PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS on Mip-NeRF360, Tanks&Temples, Deep Blending; >=1080p >=30 FPS real-time rendering vs NeRF baselines.
papers.key_contribution: Replaced implicit NeRF MLPs with an explicit primitive enabling real-time, high-quality novel-view synthesis; became the dominant scene representation.
papers.limitations: Memory-heavy for large scenes; multi-view consistent input needed; geometry (mesh extraction) requires extensions; not generative by itself.
papers.research_relevance: Backbone of 2024-2026 dynamic/scene-avatar/video-4D reconstruction and feed-forward 3D generation (e.g., Gaussian-based LRMs).
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: TRELLIS: Structured 3D Latents for Scalable and Versatile 3D Generation
papers.license_access: MIT (code and weights)
papers.methods: Structured LATent (SLAT): sparse 3D grid latents fused with multi-view DINOv2 features; rectified-flow transformers generate coarse structure then latents, decoded into radiance fields (3D Gaussians), meshes, or NeRFs; trained on 500K Objaverse/ABO/HSSD objects.
papers.benchmarks: Text/image-to-3D on Toys4K, ABO subsets; CLIP-score/ULIP/Uni3D metrics and user studies vs CLAY, Rodin Gen-1.5, Tripo3D; geometry and texture quality SOTA at release.
papers.key_contribution: Unified latent space decodable to multiple 3D output formats with state-of-the-art quality; fully open large (1.2B) image-to-3D model.
papers.limitations: Object-centric only (not full scenes); fine text alignment limited; thin structures/transparent objects remain hard.
papers.research_relevance: Reference open text/image-to-3D foundation model; SLAT reused in scene-level and 4D generation follow-ups.
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold (AlphaFold 2)
papers.license_access: Code Apache 2.0; inference params under CC BY 4.0; AlphaFold DB CC BY 4.0
papers.methods: Evoformer: attention over MSA and pair representations with triangle updates; structure module with invariant point attention producing all-atom coordinates via end-to-end training on PDB.
papers.benchmarks: CASP14 (median GDT_TS 92.4; backbone RMSD ~0.96A for top targets); accuracy near experimental methods.
papers.key_contribution: Solved the 50-year protein-folding grand challenge for single chains; AlphaFold DB gave the community 200M+ predicted structures.
papers.limitations: Requires MSAs (weak for orphans/antibodies); single static conformation; poor on complexes, ligands, nucleic acids and mutation effects (addressed by later work).
papers.research_relevance: 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry; foundation of modern computational structural biology and drug-discovery pipelines.
papers.safety_note: Predictions require experimental validation; not for clinical decisions.
papers.verification_method: arXiv API (ID->title match) and/or Crossref DOI lookup + official pages

papers.title: Accurate structure prediction of biomolecular interactions with AlphaFold 3
papers.model_data_url: https://alphafoldserver.com (free non-commercial server); inference weights downloadable for academic non-commercial use
papers.license_access: Code open (BSD-style); model weights restricted to non-commercial academic use; server free for non-commercial research
papers.methods: Diffusion-based all-atom structure generation over a tokenized representation of proteins, nucleic acids, small molecules, ions and modified residues; Pairformer replaces MSA-heavy Evoformer; confidence measures (pLDDT/pAE) calibrated for complexes.
papers.benchmarks: Protein-ligand (PoseBusters), protein-protein, protein-nucleic acid, antibody-antigen interfaces; large accuracy gains over docking tools and RoseTTAFold All-Atom; CASP15 comparisons.
papers.key_contribution: Unified, diffusion-based prediction of nearly all biomolecular complex types with substantially improved interaction accuracy.
papers.limitations: License restricts commercial use; MSA-free gains limited; conformational dynamics and disordered regions remain weak; occasional hallucinated structures (documented for IDPs).
papers.research_relevance: Standard for structure-guided biology and drug discovery; basis for open replications (Boltz, Chai-1, Protenix).

papers.title: Learning skillful medium-range global weather forecasting (GraphCast)

papers.title: Scaling deep learning for materials discovery (GNoME)
papers.model_data_url: GNoME structures released via the Materials Project (materialsproject.org) and the linked repo
papers.license_access: Code Apache 2.0; discovered structures available via Materials Project (open data)
papers.methods: Graph neural networks trained on DFT-calculated formation energies, scaled with active-learning loops: GNN filters candidate substitutions/frameworks, DFT re-validates, expanding training data iteratively (six rounds).
papers.benchmarks: Stability prediction on held-out candidates; discovery of 2.2 million candidate stable crystals, ~380k on the convex hull - expanding known stable inorganic materials ~10x; ~736 experimentally matched structures reported in follow-up analyses.
